scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && %USERPROFILE%\go\bin\air.exe" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000"
scripts.dev:no-air: concurrently "cd backend && go run main.go" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && go build -o bin/server main.go
